resolutions.researcher_notes: Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum (Sept 2024, PPC annual general assembly report) lists 'خط منتجات ميدور/الحمرا بطول 145 كم' among Petroleum Pipelines Company's national crude/products transmission-network projects. Independently, PowerNews (Aug 2021, Wayback capture — live URL now dead) reports PPC signing a contract with Petrojet for the 'El Hamra-Sidi Kerir-Midor' line to move gasoline/diesel to New Alamein, describing it as part of the same national trunk network. Two independent sources describing a long-haul trunk line operated by the national pipeline transmission company -> transmission.

PowerNews (Aug 10, 2021; live URL now dead, cited via its Wayback capture) quotes a Petroleum Authority official: the El Hamra-Sidi Kerir-Midor line is 'حوالي 140 كيلو متر وبقطر 16 بوصة' — about 140 km and 16 inches in diameter. Exact match for Diameter=16in. Single source only (the original alarabiya current_ref's own Wayback capture returns a WAF/security block page, not real content, so it cannot corroborate) -> medium.

Sheet gives StartState/Province=Cairo for this line, but every source found (petroleum.gov.eg; PowerNews 2021 archived) places the Midor-side endpoint of this pipeline in Alexandria governorate (Midor refinery / Al-Max area, per PowerNews: 'سيتم ربطه بالمنطقة الجغرافية بالإسكندرية في منطقة المكس وتوسعات ميدور'), not Cairo. Per rule 7 (no orphan refs for a value a source disagrees with), this stays UNRESOLVED rather than citing a source that actually contradicts 'Cairo' — flagging the likely province mismatch for Update to investigate.

petroleum.gov.eg (2024) names the line 'خط منتجات ميدور/الحمرا' built 'لمواكبة أعمال تطوير تسهيلات ميناء الحمرا ... بمدينة العلمين الجديدة' — i.e. terminating at El Hamra port near New Alamein (Matrouh). PowerNews (2021, archived) independently names the same 'الحمرا' endpoint and says product moves 'الي مدينة العلمين الجديدة'. Two independent sources agreeing the El Hamra/New Alamein end is real -> high, though neither spells out 'El Alamein district'/'Matrouh province' verbatim.

Sheet value is EGP 1,700,000,000. Sources found give different figures: PowerNews (2021, pre-contract estimate) says cost 'تتخطي مليار ومائتان مليون جنيه' (exceeds ~1.2bn EGP); Amwal Al Ghad (Aug 2022) cites 'بتروجت: 1.3 مليار جنيه استثمارات' (1.3bn EGP investment) for the same Midor-El Hamra products line. Neither matches 1.7bn EGP, so per rule 7 this is left UNRESOLVED rather than citing a disagreeing figure -- noting the discrepancy for Update.
